concerns.text: The 'Verified Source URL' for 'OSF Loglikelihood (Test)' points to a dataset containing log-likelihoods (`inconclusive/test-00000-of-00001.parquet`). This dataset is structurally inappropriate for the primary analysis (FR-001, FR-002) which requires `year`, `effect_size`, and `sample_size` columns to calculate post-hoc power and model temporal drift. The plan acknowledges this 'Partial' fit but fails to identify a verified alternative source that actually contains the required replication metadata. Relying on a dataset that lacks the core variables makes the primary hypothesis test impossible.

The 'OSF FC Graph Covariate Data' URLs (SreekarB/OSFData) are cited as 'Uncertain' and described as potentially containing 'covariate data for graph analysis'. There is no verification that these specific files contain the standard OSF Replication Project metadata (study_id, year, field, effect_size, N). The plan assumes one of these might work ('Assumption for Planning') without confirming the schema. If these files do not contain the required columns, the entire project scope (detecting power drift) cannot be executed with the cited resources.
